key.name: last-report-folder
key.summary: The folder the last report was saved to
key.description: The folder the last report was saved to

key.name: day-start-minutes
key.summary: At what time does the day start (defaults to 5:30AM)
key.description: The hamster day of an activity is the civil date of start time, provided start time is after day-start. On the contrary, if start time is earlier than day-start, then the activity belongs to the previous hamster day.

key.name: markdown-directory
key.description: Where the Markdown storage keeps its files, for instance a folder synchronised with other computers. Empty for the default location (hamster/markdown in the user data directory). Only used when the service runs with HAMSTER_STORAGE=markdown.
